notes: kb/Work PB1147 LANDED (w61e), re-sited by PB3990. Case 8 delegates to rules that name their condition; §14.7.4.3 r7 names EC-SIZE-TRUNCATION (cite.py OK §14.7.4.3 7)). The outermost-quotient PROHIBITED raise carried no EC name and defaulted to EC-SIZE-OVERFLOW; every rule-7 raise is now the one CobolSizeError.ProhibitedInexact (EC-SIZE-TRUNCATION), and CobolSizeError's ecName is REQUIRED (no default) so no raise site can latch a defaulted name again.
